rationale: DP1: deterministic across Node versions with node:crypto only; reuses the sorted-key idea already shipped in record-export's stableStringify; the three-hash separation is required by R02/C07 (a normalized-text hash must never rebind evidence).
summary: Canonical form for digests is compact JSON with recursively sorted keys, arrays in order, undefined dropped, UTF-8, no Unicode normalization; the digest covers the envelope minus digest and sig and is recomputed from the PARSED object so on-disk pretty-printing never matters; file bytes, canonical bytes and attachment source bytes are three distinct hashes
